tools_helpful.evidence: Seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md (3 rows) and a mechanical pass; validator later confirmed 0 residue and all rows resolved.
Caught residue/mapping/manifest issues and ran dotnet build (0 WUI analyzer warnings); gave the agent a single PASS/FAIL gate.

tools_problematic.problem: Reports '[PASS] Smoke launch — app stayed alive' purely from process liveness; a process that renders a blank/empty window passes. This gave the agent false confidence (it declared the migration complete) while the actual scenario content never rendered.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt TURN 2: '[PASS] Smoke launch — app stayed alive after launch (pid 1976)' then TURN 3 agent: 'The migration is complete and the validator reports PASS'; score note: window renders blank, ScenarioFrame empty.

tool_limitations.limitation: Fidelity snapshot only captured MainWindow.xaml title ('CameraOpenCV'); it does not assert that a navigated content Page actually rendered, so an empty initial scenario frame is invisible to it.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: HUMAN/eval-side: process-liveness is not a render check; render/parity verification belongs to the eval skills, not the migration skill.

failed_apis.why_tried: Original SDK-sample MainPage.OnNavigatedTo uses window width to decide whether to auto-select scenario 0 (>=640) or leave it unselected (<640).
failed_apis.root_cause: Agent replaced Window.Current.Bounds.Width with Page.ActualWidth. ActualWidth is 0 inside OnNavigatedTo (before the first layout pass), so the '<640' branch ran, SelectedIndex stayed -1, and ScenarioFrame.Navigate was never called.
failed_apis.fix: Read the live window size from AppWindow.Size (or defer the width-dependent logic to Loaded/SizeChanged), not Page.ActualWidth.

special_apis.special_handling: Replaced with OpenCvSharp4 (pure managed) — agent handled this well.

errors_encountered.error: Migrated app launches and stays alive but the initial scenario page never renders (empty ScenarioFrame; window appears blank).
errors_encountered.root_cause: Page.ActualWidth == 0 in OnNavigatedTo caused the adaptive branch to skip the initial ScenarioControl.SelectedIndex = 0, so no scenario was navigated.
errors_encountered.fix: Use a window-size source that is valid before layout (AppWindow.Size) or move the size check into a Loaded/SizeChanged handler.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: No struggle was visible — the agent never detected the empty render; it trusted the validator's smoke-launch PASS and declared success.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The only runtime signal available (process stayed alive) does not distinguish a rendered window from a blank one, and the Window.Current→ActualWidth substitution is silently wrong (0 before layout).
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved in-trial; surfaced only by the independent parity/score step.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A MIGRATION-PATTERNS note in the windowing anchor warning that Window.Current.Bounds size reads must NOT be replaced with Page.ActualWidth (0 pre-layout); use AppWindow.Size or defer to Loaded/SizeChanged.

env_issues.issue: First Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 invocation used a wrong relative script path and silently no-opped (VALIDATE_EXIT=0 despite 'not recognized').
env_issues.workaround: Agent re-ran with an absolute path; minor, self-corrected.
